preconditions.description: Number of servers is between 1 and 30,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i, _, _ in rules)
preconditions.description: Each server number a_i in rules is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n for _, b_i, _ in rules)
preconditions.description: Each server number b_i in rules is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= n for _, _, c_i in rules)
preconditions.description: Each server number c_i in rules is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' or starts with 'YES\n'.
If output is 'YES', the second line contains exactly 4n numbers.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('YES\n') implies all(1 <= int(num) <= 4 * n for num in return_value.split('\n')[1].split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the sequence is between 1 and 4n.
Each number in the sequence appears exactly once.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('YES\n') implies all(server[i] <= 9 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: At no time does any server have more than 9 processes.
